title: Control plane Docker connectivity failure prevents API registry queries
description: Agent successfully executed `jentic apis` commands and received responses, but platform verification shows Docker connectivity errors in the control plane when attempting to verify API details access. This suggests the control plane is not properly recording or persisting API registry queries, or the Docker networking between the test harness and control plane is broken.
reproduction_steps: Execute `jentic apis show vendor/name/version` to query the API registry
Attempt to verify in platform audit logs that the query was recorded
expected_behavior: API registry queries should be recorded in platform audit logs and accessible for verification.
actual_behavior: Agent receives successful CLI responses, but platform verification shows Docker connectivity error and no audit trail of the query.
evidence: Logged Observations: '[bug] task=find-credential | Agent narration claims successful discovery of test API (jentic-test/test-api/1.0.0) with GET /get operation, but verification failed due to Docker connectivity error in control plane.'

title: Toolkit binding requests not persisted or recorded in platform
description: Agent executed toolkit binding request command and received approval confirmation, but platform verification shows zero access requests filed and no audit trail. Either the request was not actually submitted to the platform, or the platform is not persisting/recording toolkit binding requests.
reproduction_steps: Query platform audit logs for the request
expected_behavior: Toolkit binding requests should appear in platform audit logs with request ID, timestamp, and approval status.
actual_behavior: CLI reports success, but platform shows zero access requests filed and no audit trail of request or approval.
evidence: Logged Observations: '[bug] task=add-to-toolkit | Agent narration reports successful toolkit binding request approval (tk_6a67253ca255874d60a049a7), but verification shows zero access requests filed in platform. No audit trail of request or approval.'

title: Broker execution requests not recorded in platform; test-api service unreachable
description: Agent executed a proxied GET request through the broker and received a 200 OK response with test data, but platform verification shows zero execution records and Docker connectivity error in test-api service. Either the broker is not recording executions, or the test-api service is not properly networked.
reproduction_steps: Execute `jentic execute GET /path` to make a proxied request
Query platform execution logs for the request record
expected_behavior: Proxied requests should be recorded in platform execution logs with request details, response status, and audit metadata.
actual_behavior: CLI reports successful 200 OK response, but platform shows zero execution records and Docker connectivity error in test-api service.
evidence: Logged Observations: '[bug] task=make-proxied-request | Agent narration claims successful 200 OK proxied GET request through broker with test response body, but verification shows zero execution records in platform and Docker connectivity error in test-api service. No evidence of request reaching platform or API.'
